subject: A cry of 'attack on India', and the vote-theft arrow in the back
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: on the left stands an elderly man with a white beard and glasses, in an orange kurta, his right hand covering his face; his eyes are shut and his mouth open, as if in a sigh. On the right a man stands with his back to us, in a brown sleeveless jacket over a white kurta; a large orange lotus sits on his head and back, and his arms are spread wide. A speech bubble at the upper left says: ATTACK ON INDIA! From the right a brown arrow flies at the man’s back, and a pale blue paper tied to it reads: VOTE CHORI. The cartoonist’s signature, SATISH ACHARYA, is at the lower right.
chutki: An elderly man stands with a hand over his face. In front of him a man stands with his back turned, a large lotus on his head and back, both arms spread, and it is he who is shouting: ATTACK ON INDIA! An arrow flies in from the right at his back, and the paper tied to it says: VOTE CHORI.

The needle is in the timing. The cry of 'an attack on India' goes up while the vote-theft arrow is already in the back; the question that has to be dodged has been renamed as the nation. And the old man with his face covered says the noise is hollow inside.
